title: Polynomial reduction of diagonal derived Hom
statement:
Let $R\to A$ be a flat finitely presented homomorphism of commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Choose a polynomial presentation $P=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\twoheadrightarrow A$ and put $C=R\operatorname{Hom}_P(A,P)[n]\in D(A)$, with the $A$-action by precomposition. Work in ordinary module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with derived tensor and internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-object ringed site. Put $B=A\otimes_R A$ and $p_1(a)=a\otimes1$, and give $A$ its $B$-module structure by multiplication. Let $T\in D(A)$ be pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex] and have finite Tor amplitude over $R$: some integers $a\le b$ satisfy $H^i(T\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}Q)=0$ for every $R$-module $Q$ and $i\notin[a,b]$. Then there is an isomorphism, natural in $T$, in $D(A)$
$$\operatorname{Res}_{p_1}R\operatorname{Hom}_B(A,T\otimes_{A,p_1}^{\mathbf L}B)\ \cong\ R\operatorname{Hom}_A(C,T).$$
Here $\operatorname{Res}_{p_1}$ is restriction along the coprojection $A\to B$, not along multiplication $B\to A$. No diagonal dualizing condition on $T$ is assumed.
